subject: [PATCH v2 1/3] mm/huge_memory: skip zone device folios in madvise_free_huge_pmd()

2026-08-17.patch_summary: This patch modifies the madvise_free_huge_pmd() function to skip zone device folios when performing lazyfree operations. The existing guards in this function do not cover all cases of zone device memory, and adding a check for zone device folios ensures that these areas are properly handled. This change addresses an issue where THP migration of zone device pages was not being filtered correctly.
